tone.target: bright 80s rack-clean pop rock with chorus shimmer
tone.profile: bright 80s rack-clean pop rock with chorus shimmer
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a Comp for punch, followed by Chorus for the signature shimmer, running through a classic British clean amp model (UK SLP) paired with a clear cabinet (UK Vintage 4x12).
corrections: push 80s polish over generic pop rock
